title: Hyprune IPC 0.31: primitives and materials in the builder (placement keys, dry runs, asset swaps)

hint.description: How to fix it, in one short sentence (RFC-0016 operation rules).

field.description: The parameter the error is about.

id.description: The placement a key names (rule key.taken).

version.description: Input version 3: Ctrl+R toggles a recording (world mode); Shift sprints and Ctrl goes down, as in version 2 (IPC 0.29 first swapped the two; a keymap still at that swap is restored once). Peers before 0.29 see version 2.

invert_y.description: Invert vertical mouse look; default false.

show_area_markers.description: Render optional place/area labels in core; default false.

submode.description: With tool 9, the shown debug layer id (editor.debugTool.layer).

toolDefinitions.description: Slots 1-5 in order, then the debug tool (slot 9).

offload_power_cap_w.description: Offload renderer power cap in watts. Null (the default) is automatic: the battery profile ceiling on systems with a battery, otherwise 75 % of the offload GPU's enforced power limit (80 W when unknown). A number can only lower the profile ceiling with a battery and is clamped to the GPU's enforced limit without one.

offload_device.description: "auto" (the default) or the lowercase PCI address (domain:bus:device.function) of the GPU that runs the offload renderer. Auto prefers an NVIDIA render node that is not the compositor's GPU, then the least utilised; an unavailable explicit address stops offload with reason "offload device unavailable".

upscaler.description: Reconstruction when the world renders below output size: AMD FidelityFX FSR 1 (EASU + RCAS) or bilinear + bounded unsharp mask. Null inherits the preset; bilinear is also used when the GPU lacks GLSL ES 3.1.

npc_motion.description: Character animation (default auto): auto animates only on mains power (offload power profile full-ac or limited-ac and not discharging); battery, USB-C and unknown supplies pause. Same value as Lua npc.motion.

frame_pacing.description: Frame pacing of a rate-capped renderer (null: the preset). even: new frames on a steady refresh divisor at a constant latency; max_rate: as many as the cap allows, unevenly spaced.

offload_power_cap_w.description: Offload renderer power cap in watts. Null (the default) is automatic: the battery profile ceiling on systems with a battery, otherwise 75 % of the offload GPU's enforced power limit (80 W when unknown). A number can only lower the profile ceiling with a battery and is clamped to the GPU's enforced limit without one.

offload_device.description: "auto" (the default) or the lowercase PCI address (domain:bus:device.function) of the GPU that runs the offload renderer. Auto prefers an NVIDIA render node that is not the compositor's GPU, then the least utilised; an unavailable explicit address stops offload with reason "offload device unavailable".

upscaler.description: Reconstruction when the world renders below output size: AMD FidelityFX FSR 1 (EASU + RCAS) or bilinear + bounded unsharp mask. Null inherits the preset; bilinear is also used when the GPU lacks GLSL ES 3.1.

npc_motion.description: Character animation (default auto): auto animates only on mains power (offload power profile full-ac or limited-ac and not discharging); battery, USB-C and unknown supplies pause. Same value as Lua npc.motion.

frame_pacing.description: Frame pacing of a rate-capped renderer (null: the preset). even: new frames on a steady refresh divisor at a constant latency; max_rate: as many as the cap allows, unevenly spaced.

timings.description: Extensible diagnostic measurements; GPU timings can be null when unavailable.

name.description: The slot's tool name: pointer, mount, path, position, placement (or a configured name for slots 1-5), or debug for slot 9.

capSource.description: Where capW comes from: profile = battery-present laptop rules; device = no battery, 75 % of the GPU's enforced power limit; configured = offload_power_cap_w (clamped to the profile ceiling with a battery, or to the GPU's enforced limit without one); fallback = no battery and the limit is unknown (80 W).

device.description: The GPU chosen for the offload renderer, or null when none is chosen yet or none is available. drivesCompositor is true when it is the GPU the compositor renders with.

last.description: The last finished recording this session and its label (null until labelled).

look_inertia.description: Mouse look smoothing time constant (s); 0 = raw.

view_bob_roll.description: Head tilt of the walking bob at a full stride (degrees), one left-right cycle per stride; 0 = none.

carry_turn.description: Time (s) a carried window takes to turn toward facing you (critically damped); 0 = rigid.

carry_follow.description: Time (s) a carried window's grab point takes to follow the centre ray (critically damped); 0 = rigid.

playerPatch.description: Changed keys only; null removes the persisted override (back to the default).

playerOverrides.description: Persisted player overrides (never null; may be empty).

questRef.description: A quest reference: source ("personal", a world ID or a provider ID) and the quest slug.

questTarget.description: Exactly one of position (optionally with worldId), zoneId, areaId, placeId or workspaceId.

markerSource.description: Where a marker comes from ("open in Quests"); questId is "<source>/<id>".

guidanceMarker.description: A resolved marker (RFC-0012). id is "<kind>:<source id>" (at most 160 bytes); position is null when the target is not in the loaded world; range is [min, max] metres with min < max. Kinds and icons beyond quest, waypoint, route, home, workspace, place, focus and break (plus quest-optional and vista icons) are reserved for later quest sources.

markersState.description: Marker reveal and the resolved marker list (sorted by tier, then id). reveal.holdMs 0 is toggle mode; *AtMs are CLOCK_MONOTONIC milliseconds.

questsState.description: Active quests (tracked first) and counts. world is reserved and always null in this version.

focusState.description: The focus session. Phase times are CLOCK_MONOTONIC milliseconds (null when idle, ready or paused); remainingMs is at publication time; creditedMs and crediting are sampled at most every 10 s and on every phase change.

guidanceConfig.description: Every guidance setting (effective values or defaults).

guidanceOverrides.description: Persisted guidance overrides (never null; may be empty).

guidancePatch.description: Changed keys only; null removes the persisted override (back to the default).

objectiveInput.description: manual: the user marks it done. reach: target (default the step target; one of them must exist), radius in metres (default 4; area/zone bounds for area and zone targets). focus: sessions, minutes per session (default 0.8 x focus.work_min), focusTarget (default quest: only sessions started from this quest count).

stepInput.description: id defaults to step-N; objectives default to [{"id": "done", "type": "manual"}].

personalQuestInput.description: A personal quest definition. On create, id is derived from the title when absent; on update it is ignored (questRef wins). expires is a local date-time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

focusOverrides.description: One-off values for this session (work_min may go below the 5-minute setting floor).

focusInterval.description: One finished interval (also one line of focus/history.jsonl). Never titles.

style.description: A user character's or the companion's styles (null: plain clips; always null for other objects).

key.description: A user placement's key, else null.

behaviours.description: A user placement's behaviours now: the value read, its condition and t (0..1, before smoothing); null without any.

anyOf.description: Companion capability of a character entry (null for other objects); reason names the first failing rule.

warnings.description: Validation warnings: measures over their recommendation (object format 0.11) and other notes.

workspace.description: Workspace screens only: as objects.configure; omitted means "next-free".

ifExists.description: With a key that names a placement: error (default) refuses with rule key.taken and its id; update moves that placement to this pose and scale (and to this ref when it differs) instead.

dryRun.description: Check everything (ref, budgets, placement rules) and answer what would happen; nothing changes.

updated.description: ifExists update moved an existing placement.

removed.description: False when a key named no placement (removing a missing key succeeds).

workspace.description: A workspace number, "next-free" (the lowest workspace above workspace_base that is no home yet) or null (none).

ref.description: Another catalog entry in the same place (a user placement keeps its id, key and pose; a rebuilt primitive, say). Placement rules apply to the new asset; a workspace binding stays only when it is a screen too.

key.description: Name or rename the placement (null removes the key).

behaviours.description: The placement's behaviours, the whole list ([] removes them); user placements only.

pathId.description: A path id: a package path slug, or a user path id (path-<n>).

pathRef.description: A qualified path reference: package/<id> or user/<id>.

pathParam.description: A path reference in params; a bare id means package/<id>.

seatRef.description: A world seats[] id, <objectId>/<anchorId> or <objectId> (any free anchor).

npcAccent.description: Linear RGB for the accent material.

npcSpeed.description: Scales the character's walk (pace and clip rate).

pathStop.description: The world 0.9 stop: seconds (default 3) and at most one of clip, face or seat.

anyOf.description: Why characters are paused: inactive, typing, focus, free cursor, idle, battery, usb-c power, power unknown or reduced motion.

options.description: Choices of a dance interaction (one per dance); null for other types.

anyOf.description: The character under the reticle within use distance.
The running interaction, or the choice list (type choose).

npcsState.description: Characters (RFC-0010/RFC-0011 P2): motion setting, effective state, budgets, drawing, aim and the running interaction.

pathRecord.description: walkable is null for paths that are not routes; problems name the first walkability failures with positions.

userPath.description: A user path; without id core creates path-<n>.

style.description: Walk, run and idle styles (null: plain clips).
Walk, run and idle styles (null: plain clips).

option.description: A dance interaction: the option chosen (else one at random).

machineInputKey.description: An input id; a repeated input appears expanded as id.1 ... id.N.

machineInput.description: A typed machine input as declared in object.json traits.machine.inputs (object manifest 0.10, RFC-0013); repeat is not expanded.

catalogMachine.description: The entry's machine trait: the primary input (null: none declared) and the declared inputs.

liveInput.description: One input of a live instance: its binding (source and key, null when unbound), the mapped value, the published raw value (null without data), the condition and the wall-clock Unix ms of the publication core holds (null when missing).

liveInstance.description: A bound machine instance. source is the source every bound input reads (null when they differ or none is bound); status and error are that source's _status and _error.

liveState.description: Live machine state (RFC-0013), published on change and never per frame.

companion.set.params.description: Chooses the companion: a companion-capable catalog character (library or user). Persisted in user state.

companion.mode.params.description: follow: unbind and follow the player; stay: stand where it is (this world). pace (optional): walk or run while following; kept across modes and companions. style (optional): its walk, run and idle styles (null: plain); kept across modes and companions.

pace.description: The pace it keeps while following.

style.description: Its styles (kept across modes and companions).

dance.description: The dance it is dancing (activity dancing), else null.

companionState.description: The companion (RFC-0010 companions amendment): the chosen character, its mode and what it is doing.

debugTool.description: Tool 9, the debug tool (null while another tool is out): the shown layer (id, HUD label, 0-based index of count), its legend (sRGB colours, 0-1) and the info card Primary opened (null: none). Core draws the banner, legend and card itself.

catalogScreen.description: A workspace screen's mounted-workspace anchor: its aspect and size in metres at scale 1.

instanceScreen.description: A placed workspace screen: the workspace it shows (null: none) and, while it is a home, the area id of that home in mounts.areas and mounts.bindings; size is the anchor's size at the instance's scale.

catalogProvenance.description: The object's recorded licence, author and source ("unknown" where unrecorded).

catalogImported.description: From import.json: when and from which file it was imported.

builderState.description: A world folder loaded in editor mode (RFC-0014): its placements are written to builder/project.json (revision counts the writes: pending changes for the next Save). error: the last write that failed.

motionStyle.description: A clip style of the shared clip library (RFC-0010 amendment): walk_confident plays for walk with style confident.

characterStyle.description: Styles a character plays for walk, run and idle; a role without a style plays its plain clip.

catalogMotion.description: A character entry's clips beyond its own (null for other objects): the styles and dances it can play, its own and from motion packs, and the packs that filled them.

recordingStats.description: Statistics of a debug recording window (about 5 s): presents and new frames per second, present intervals (frameMs), the dt ticks moved by, missed refreshes and hitches (present intervals over 2.5x the median and over two refreshes, seconds since the recording started).

recordingState.description: The debug recording (Ctrl+R): whether one runs, since when (core steady clock, ms), its path and latest statistics, and the last finished one.

last.description: The last finished recording this session and its label (null until labelled).

meta.description: What the labelling client adds to the sidecar (e.g. its version); under 4 KiB.

settingsEntry.description: A governed setting: its effective value, its default under the selected preset, and where the value comes from (user: an explicit override, survives preset switches; lua: the compositor config; preset: the default).

values.description: What the preset sets, beyond the base defaults.

defaults.description: Every governed setting's default under this preset.

settings.set.params.description: Applied in order: resetAll (every graphics, player and keymap override; the preset stays), preset, reset, set.

objectKey.description: A caller-chosen stable name for a user placement, unique among this world's placements (RFC-0016 operation rules).

catalogPrimitive.description: A generated primitive (primitive.json beside object.json): its shape, size in metres and material.

behaviour.description: A data-driven display behaviour (RFC-0014 amendment): one published value drives one property between A (from) and B (to). Display only.

input.description: The value read: min..max (default 0..100) maps to A..B.
